data.summary: The analysis is not accurate because the net income figure is wrong. Amazon's FY2024 net income was about $59.2 billion, not $74.1 billion. The other figures are correct: revenue of $638.0B, up 11% from $574.8B; operating income of $68.6B; total assets of $624.9B; and cash and cash equivalents of $78.8B.
